name: Veggie omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with a splash of milk.
Soften chopped vegetables in a pan.
Pour in eggs, add cheese, fold.

name: Fried rice
steps: Use cold cooked rice.
Scramble eggs, set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice and soy sauce, return eggs.

name: Chicken stir-fry
steps: Slice chicken thin and sear.
Add vegetables and garlic.
Sauce with soy, serve over rice.

name: Pasta primavera
steps: Boil pasta.
Saute garlic and vegetables.
Toss with pasta and parmesan.

name: Tomato egg stir-fry
steps: Scramble eggs softly, remove.
Cook tomatoes until saucy with a pinch of sugar.
Fold eggs back in, top with green onion.

name: Yogurt parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola.
Drizzle honey.

name: Banana smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Quesadilla
steps: Fill a tortilla with cheese and fillings.
Toast both sides until melted.
Serve with salsa.

name: Grilled cheese and tomato soup
steps: Simmer tomatoes and onion, blend with a little milk.
Butter bread, grill with cheese.

name: Chicken soup
steps: Simmer chicken with vegetables in water 25 min.
Shred chicken, add noodles, cook until tender.

name: Caesar-ish salad
steps: Toast bread cubes.
Whisk lemon, oil and grated parmesan.
Toss with lettuce; top with boiled egg.

name: Overnight oats
steps: Mix oats, milk and yogurt.
Chill overnight, top with fruit.

name: Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, milk, egg and melted butter.
Cook spoonfuls on a hot pan, flip when bubbly.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Cook onion, pepper and garlic.
Add tomatoes and simmer.
Crack eggs in, cover until set, top with feta.

name: Tuna salad sandwich
steps: Mix tuna, mayo and diced celery.
Pile on bread with lettuce.

name: Mushroom risotto
steps: Toast rice with onion.
Add warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring.
Stir in sauteed mushrooms, butter and parmesan.

name: Black bean tacos
steps: Warm beans with spices.
Fill tortillas, top with avocado, tomato and lime.

name: Baked salmon and greens
steps: Roast salmon and broccoli at 400F for 12-15 min with lemon and garlic.
Serve with rice.

name: Pho-style beef noodle soup
steps: Simmer broth with charred onion and ginger.
Pour over noodles and thin raw beef slices.
Top with green onion and lime.

name: Fruit salad
steps: Chop fruit, toss gently, top with yogurt.

name: Cheesy potato hash
steps: Pan-fry diced potatoes until crisp.
Add onion and pepper.
Top with eggs and cheese, cover until set.

name: Spinach and ham frittata
steps: Whisk eggs and milk.
Cook spinach, ham and onion in an oven-safe pan.
Add eggs and cheese, finish under the broiler.

name: Cucumber yogurt salad
steps: Slice cucumber, mix with yogurt, garlic, lemon and dill.

name: Leftover rice porridge
steps: Simmer rice in broth until creamy.
Stir in a beaten egg, top with ginger and green onion.
